[Turnaround]
{a short turnaround that leads smoothly straight back into the main theme, same tempo and key}
positive_styles: driving pulse-wave lead with an urgent climbing minor melody
pounding eighth-note synth bass, no rest
dark pipe-organ chords and tense string pad
eerie detuned high shimmer like light draining away
relentless driving drums with ratcheting fills
seamless transition back to the theme
